issues.question: Which surveyed or explicitly fictional geometry will support motion prediction?
issues.required_evidence: Document coordinate frame, units, origin/CRS, accuracy, source and review. No coordinates may be added to v1 drafts.

issues.question: Where exactly are each approach-side hold line and protected boundary?
issues.required_evidence: Expert review, source-marked location, approach direction and independent coordinates; split segments at verified boundaries.

issues.question: Which closures, access restrictions and direction permissions apply at the exercise time?
issues.required_evidence: Applicable chart cycle, NOTAMs, airport restrictions, review timestamp; expiry-time semantics not inferred from printed dates.

issues.question: Does the October 2026 AL-58 diagram match the June 2026 Logan event geometry?
issues.required_evidence: June-cycle chart and change comparison. Incident distances/timings from reports must not be used as graph geometry.

issues.question: Are the visible links and intervening junctions correct and sufficient for the chosen route?
issues.required_evidence: Expert-marked diagram; accepted node order and hold boundaries; retain alternatives until resolved.

issues.question: Which independent observations establish actor position, speed and uncertainty?
issues.required_evidence: Timestamped observed or explicitly simulated tracks, actor association, uncertainty, footprint, stale-input rules and time basis.

issues.question: Confirm the HS 4 LAHSO line is for runway 15R arrivals holding short of 09/27, its current availability/conditions and physical marking.
issues.required_evidence: Chart Supplement LAHSO entry for BOS plus expert review; record no available-landing-distance value in v1. Never treat the line as a clearance or a prediction boundary.

issues.question: East of D2, unlabeled pavement continues from D and curves south to runway 9/27 near the 27 threshold. Is it part of D, part of D2, or unnamed?
issues.required_evidence: Expert reading or larger-scale source; not added to the graph until identified.

issues.question: West of 15R/33L, C branches from D and crosses 9/27 inside HS 4. Should a D/C junction be modeled so the west-side D hold for 15R/33L can be represented?
issues.required_evidence: Expert-confirmed junction order west of 15R/33L; currently no west-side node, so no west-side hold record.

issues.question: What protected area should conflict logic use around the 09/27 x 15R/33L crossing?
issues.required_evidence: Reviewed metric boundaries. HS 4 ellipse is offset west of the runway crossing and must not be used as an occupancy polygon.

issues.question: Parser aliases now include digit-plus-spoken-suffix forms (runway 33 left, delta 1). Confirm these match the ASR output style.
issues.required_evidence: ASR transcripts from re-voiced or fictional audio; aliases are parser conveniences, not chart facts.
